storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Her ethereal beauty is always reminiscent of the bird of heaven, spreading its glossy wings towards utopia as her white dress flutters with caressing breezes.

However, does the girl who perches on the mast ever imagine herself flying in the azure sky?

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
On July 3, A.F.3@1, being invited by the Nathaniel Forbes Green Foundation, Mythag University participated in the investigation towards the "ghost ship" Sona-Nyl.

Upon boarding the barque which had been declared sunk ten years ago, the communication signal from investigator Fingal Johansen had immediately out of reach.

On July 10, A.F.3@1, the university eventually managed to get him. Located at the northern shore of Leo Heights with 300 nautical miles away from the original destination, investigator Johansen declared that he lost sense of time and space at the second he stepped on Sona-Nyl, and could not recall anything that happened onboard.

Investigator Johansen can hitherto only vaguely remember a word: Elysian.

Due to the unharmful nature of the ghost ship itself, Mythag University decide to terminate the investigation today (A.F.3@1 year, December 24).

"File: Investigation of the Sona-Nyl Crash."

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Grabbed by Doll upon the moment of joining the university, Celeste has undergone a series of comprehensive assessment.

As an Awakener summoned from non-standard process, Celeste's mental state is incredibly stable. However, neither her spirit intensity nor her Gnostic index which evaluates the strength of slivercore meets the Awakener's standard.

Yet she still emerged into this world as an Awakener, like a flower with invisible petals brusts in abysmal nothingness.

Although no abnormalities has shown in daily activities or field missions, data record reveals Celeste's concerning situation: her will, already faint, continues to evansce.

By now, the Awakening Department is organizing a small order to sustain Celeste's existence by supplying religious belief. Those who are interested in joining and proficient in aquatic activities could contact Teacher Sylvia for further infomation.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
On the thirty-first day following the celestial bird, Sona-Nyl sails into a sea shrouded by streaming mist.

Celeste perches high on the mast, gazing upon her people below. Notes of the lutanist drift in sweet melodies. Songs praying for a smooth journey echo betwixt.

She does not aware of their destination, nor does she evaluate how much wealth and fame bestowing across the sea. She does not care whether the prayers are pious, nor does she unsettled by the rumors about her power, circulating surreptitiously around the sea. Being asked to bless the voyage, she does not need words to complete her duty.

And when the music ceases and the mist lifts, the sailors behold only a resistless raging sea. Lightning tears through the sky. Black rain pours down, bursting thunders of gigantic spray. Rushing torrent captures the fragile barque and throws it into the gaping abyss.

"God has forsaken us!" Kindreds scream in desperation. Bellows imprison her into the lightless dungeon.

Neglected and derelicted, the protector is left alone unquestioned with her failed duty, and one last lingering confusion.

Why... why did the barque sink?

The chain that once manacled her to the mast drown into the roaring splash. She plummets into the depth...

Like a white bird with snapped wings flaking from the sky.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Our good friend, the resourceful Hannah Peaslee, somehow dug up the research materials on Celeste. Thanks to this audacious reporter, both the originally confidential materials and her brief interview with Celeste has now spreaded into every corner.

After reading the confidential materials, Hannah posed a question to her usually emotionless face.

"Most Awakeners have unfulfilled wishes, which lie in their basic motivations for cooperating with the university. However, your wish section is blank in this material. Don't you have any desire to accomplish anything? Or what is your meaning as an Awakener?"

"I have, I do have."

The girl's expression showed no cracks, as ethereal and noble as usual. If it were not for that brief answer and the anxiety within, the reporter would have almost thought that she miss the question.


"I will find my wish... everyone wishes so. Therefore I will find it."

Her soft voice resounded, delicate and fragile like an easily shattered dream.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: My name is Celeste. I'll always be here, as long as you still need me.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: As you wished, my existence has grown more tangible.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: It has arrived... the white bird circling in my dream.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: Hmm... the sea water is quite warm tonight...

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: Do you wish for me to set sail once more? I am willing to do so... if you do not mind my past failure.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: I seem to hear the rowers' shanties again... and sense the familiar scent of home.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: Please follow the trail of the birds of paradise; the destination awaits ahead in the azure blue.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: The destination, be it treasure or port, makes no difference to me. My purpose is only to ensure your safe return.

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: Thanks to your favor, even the raging seas now feel less daunting. I shall brave them to bring you my steadfast blessings.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: I often gaze at the horizon, imagining the scenes on that distant land—the one I draw closer to but can never reach. If that day ever comes, please come with me to see it.

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Duty and destiny are much alike. Neither can be easily cast aside, nor is there any need to cast them aside.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: My past was routine and calm, like the seas near the equator; there is nothing worth mentioning.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: My wish? Ensuring safe and peaceful voyage—does that not suffice? I have never had any other wishes... but I will consider it carefully and tell you later.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: Miss Ramona once said that I don't need to accommodate everyone. I do not understand... Does it mean my protection is no longer needed?

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: I was brought to the ship and entrusted with the mission of the ship's maiden many years ago. Since then, my life—and its meaning—have been beyond my control. I've been told that I should live for my own wishes, at least in this second life as an Awakener... Would you help me? Help me become selfish, help me find my own wish.

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Would you like to sink together with me?

daily.title: Chat: About Past
daily.content: Ah... Are you talking to me? My apologies, I was lost in memories of the view back when I was bound to the mast. Would you mind repeating your question?

daily.title: Chat: About Miryam
daily.content: Blessing the voyage for most people makes no difference to me... except for that woman. If possible, please arrange another route for me.

daily.title: Chat: About Faros
daily.content: That would be a dangerous person to have on board... No, I mean purely from a navigation safety perspective...

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: I was punished for failing to protect the sailors, who were lost to their families forever. They named me the chief culprit of the tragedy... Is this what Dissolution is?

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: Thanks to Miss Hannah, I was able to observe the choir practice. Hymns and sea shanties are quite different; during my years of blessing voyages, I've never heard such a unique melody...

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: The full moon's golden light always enchants me: beneath it, the sea catches the light and shimmers beautifully as the mysterious, gentle wind blows, weaving a romantic and dreamlike vision.

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: It's getting a bit noisy... are those the students? They are much like albatrosses, you see? They have endless vitality, as if their journey never ends...

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: My relationship with you is like that of a sail and a ship. Without the ship, the sail shouldn't exist; without the sail, the ship can hardly voyage far. Is that not true?

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: Souls without protection, I shall grant you final peace.

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: Everything went well. You may raise the triumphant sails.

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: So my protection, too, may fail at times...

battle.title: Skill: I
battle.content: May you have a sweet dream.

battle.title: Skill: II
battle.content: To the best of my ability.

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: Bird soaring in the azure sky, please heed my prayer.
